from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
import hashlib, json, subprocess
root = Path.cwd()
out = root / "reports/research/510300_original_collection_inventory_joint_state_decomposition_v1"
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
def now():
    return datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def read(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
def save(name, data):
    path = out / name
    if path.exists():
        raise RuntimeError("登记已有，禁止覆盖或重复运行：" + str(path))
    path.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return {"path": str(path.relative_to(root)).replace("\\", "/"), "sha256": sha(path)}
proposal_path = root / "reports/research/510300_original_operating_counterexample_causes_v1/next_experiment.json"
proposal = read(proposal_path)
if proposal["experiment_id"] != "E112" or proposal["status"] != "PROPOSED_NOT_REGISTERED_NOT_RUN":
    raise RuntimeError("非原E112未运行提案")
parents = list(proposal["parents"])
extra = [
"reports/research/510300_original_operating_counterexample_causes_v1/result.json",
"reports/research/510300_joint_operating_state_continuity_counterexamples_v1/protocol.json",
"reports/research/510300_joint_operating_state_continuity_counterexamples_v1/全部79原身份_同钟共同条件与下一原经营公布_未知保留.json",
"reports/research/510300_original_producer_price_full_joint_source_v1/全部79原期_实际价格资金订单回款库存利润与有年龄基金共同状态_v1_0_1.json",
"reports/research/510300_original_producer_price_full_joint_source_v1/source_gate_v1_0_1.json",
"reports/research/510300_enterprise_multidimensional_original_state_discovery_v1/protocol.json"
]
for item in parents:
    if sha(root / item["path"]) != item["sha256"]:
        raise RuntimeError("提案父证据身份不符：" + item["path"])
for relpath in [str(proposal_path.relative_to(root)).replace("\\", "/"), *extra]:
    if not any(item["path"].replace("\\", "/") == relpath for item in parents):
        parents.append({"path": relpath, "sha256": sha(root / relpath)})
transition = read(root / extra[2])
joint = read(root / extra[3])
known = [row for row in transition["rows"] if row["transition_status"] == "KNOWN_SAME_SCOPE_NEXT_ORIGINAL_PUBLICATION"]
if len(transition["rows"]) != 79 or len(joint["rows"]) != 79 or len(known) != 76:
    raise RuntimeError("原79/76身份范围不符")
cfg = read(root / "config/510300_historical_cause_discovery_v1.json")
prior_audit = cfg.get("latest_goal_turn_audit", {})
if prior_audit.get("current_turn_experiment_ids") != ["E111"]:
    raise RuntimeError("先前目标turn不符，需要先读取新的权威状态")
prior_use = save("有限已有用途界定与解释侧表准入_E112.json", {
    "at": now(), "previous_goal_turn": {"experiment_ids": ["E111"], "classification": "PROGRESS", "evidence": extra[0], "actual_queries": 5, "actual_unique_cause_reads": 3},
    "closest_prior_descriptive_use": {"experiment_id": "E87", "population": "29企业家调查季度、9扩散意见字段、5同印刷周转组及4合取状态", "difference": "本轮只展开79规上工业原实际财务量的回款/库存量与时间完整16组合及原76关系，不将调查意见或其旧失败重新拟合"},
    "closest_prior_operating_use": {"experiment_id": "E110", "role": "八价格/资金/订单联合条件、三个固定经营结果、四基准", "difference": "本轮只分解原复合False及列全16格/转换/反例，不替换任何旧结果或收益特征"},
    "prior_nonlinear_financial_failures": {"experiments": ["E100", "E106"], "status": "REJECTED_FROZEN", "not_rescued": True},
    "this_sidecar_is_new_description_not_new_independent_information": True,
    "source_search_scope_is_bounded_not_whole_repo_exhaustive": True,
    "old_closed_sources_and_unknowns_preserved": True,
    "financial_admission": False
})
state_codes = [
    {"code": prefix + bits, "label": labels[i], "quantity_condition": ">" if bits[0] == "1" else "<=", "time_condition": ">0" if bits[1] == "1" else "<=0"}
    for prefix, labels in [("C", proposal["sidecar_joint_cells"]["collection"]), ("I", proposal["sidecar_joint_cells"]["inventory"])]
    for i, bits in enumerate(["11", "10", "01", "00"])
]
protocol = {
    "experiment_id": "E112", "study_id": proposal["study_id"], "registered_at": now(),
    "status": "REGISTERED_BEFORE_SINGLE_LOCAL_JOINT_STATE_RUN",
    "question": proposal["question"], "hypothesis": proposal["hypothesis"],
    "unit_of_analysis": proposal["unit_of_analysis"],
    "fixed_original_population": proposal["fixed_original_population"],
    "fixed_state_codes": state_codes,
    "complete_joint_cells": [c["code"] + "_" + inv["code"] for c in state_codes if c["code"].startswith("C") for inv in state_codes if inv["code"].startswith("I")],
    "native_comparison_rule": "量以原应收/库存同比与原同范围收入同比比较，时间以原同比天数差和0比较；>与<=原语义固定，不调交易阈值。缺失/非有限值UNKNOWN，不进入<=。",
    "same_clock_rule": "只复制原E110当前量和E109同钟全部共同背景；原下一公布量和原因仅作历史结果，不进当前状态。",
    "transition_rule": "沿原E110全部76同范围/自己的公开时间在当前截止之后的下一原公布；跨年累计重置及缺1月照原样保留并标注，不删或跳期。其他3原身份UNKNOWN。",
    "complete_transition_matrix": "全部16当前格×16下一格，保存256单元，包括0与未知计数，不按结果选格。",
    "old_outcomes_and_baselines": "复制原E110三个经营布尔结果/A—H/四基准及分母，不以新16格替代；表中每个结果列完整真例和反例、原个体身份。",
    "coexistence_rule": "原利润同比>0只作当前并存事实，与回款/库存状态同时展示，不据结果再细分或挑金融样本。",
    "observed_run_rule": "同格相邻且原实际日历月份相隔1、三原范围相同才可见连续；缺1月/范围切换/末端是观察边界，不声称独立事件或独立新样本。",
    "unknown_and_empty_rule": "空格COUNT0，结果比例NOT_COMPUTED；字段/范围/下一公布未知单独保留。原价格缺自身钟的数值不升格为当前可知输入。",
    "financial_budget": proposal["trial_budget_proposed"],
    "price_financial_gate_unchanged": read(root / extra[4]),
    "parents": parents + [prior_use],
    "original79_1711_1212_identities_preserved": True,
    "fixed_old_conditions_outcomes_baselines_and_denominators_unchanged": True,
    "one_local_execution_only": True, "new_linear_regressions": 0, "new_simple_weighted_scores": 0,
    "no_optimization": proposal["no_optimization"],
    "case_and_source_already_observed": True, "historical_first_vintage_authenticated": False,
    "independent_validation": False, "financial_admission_pass": False,
    "net_sharpe": "NOT_COMPUTED", "goal_achieved": False, "current_view": "NO_VIEW", "position": "UNSET",
    "orders_authorized": False, "prospective_forecasts": False
}
assert len(protocol["complete_joint_cells"]) == 16 and len(set(protocol["complete_joint_cells"])) == 16
registration = save("protocol.json", protocol)
def git(*args):
    return subprocess.run(["git", *args], capture_output=True, text=True, encoding="utf-8", check=True).stdout
save("运行前git记录_E112.json", {"at": now(), "branch": git("branch", "--show-current").strip(), "HEAD": git("rev-parse", "HEAD").strip(), "tracked_status": git("status", "--short", "--untracked-files=no"), "existing_source_code_edits": 0})
print(json.dumps({"registered": registration, "original_periods": 79, "same_scope_transitions": 76, "joint_cells": 16, "complete_transition_cells": 256, "local_run_budget": 1, "new_financial_candidates": 0, "previous_goal_turn": "PROGRESS_E111"}, ensure_ascii=False))
